_about: Engine gaps recorded by earlier verified work. cardkit marks matching cards ENGINE_BLOCKED and routes them to Claude. Add an entry only with a source (issue, PR, doc) that reproduced the gap on the pinned engine; remove it when the primitive lands. 'verified': false = reported by a worker but not yet independently reproduced. 'patterns' match normalized rules text (card name → ~, numbers → n) so every card that needs the same missing primitive is classified the same way.

Acolyte Hybrid.reason: needs the outcome of one specific Destroy (did it destroy that artifact?) to give its controller a draw; no effect-local destroy result

Alms Collector.reason: replace only the extra cards of a multi-card draw and redistribute them

Arcane Lighthouse.reason: until end of turn, opponents' creatures lose hexproof and shroud AND can't have either; only hexproof suppression exists

Azlask, the Swelling Scourge.reason: dies-trigger subject filter cannot test colorless: TriggerMatcher.matchesCardPredicate has no branch for CardPredicate.IsColorless (throws IllegalStateException at runtime); TriggeringEntityWas accepts only type/subtype predicates

Bruvac the Grandiloquent.reason: mill multiplier; the engine's mill modifier only adds a fixed amount

Chittering Dispatcher.reason: The current Android-consumer runtime lacks CR 702.116a's Myriad defender choice (other opponent OR a planeswalker they control). A real three-player scenario reaches optional token creation but no required ChooseTargetsDecision; two-player no-copy tests do not establish full support.
Chittering Dispatcher.source: #34 / #36 / #181, exact-head Development CI 40157943733 (577 tests, only new multiplayer Myriad gate fails at line 68)

Determined Iteration.reason: cannot give the populated token haste and schedule its sacrifice

Devil Dinosaur.reason: opponent-only hexproof static is rejected by the pinned SDK at script init

Doubling Cube.reason: doubling the mana already in a mana pool

Ephemerate.reason: immediate exile-and-return of any creature plus rebound (recorded as limited to double-faced cards before the 2026-10-22 engine upgrade)
Ephemerate.recheck: Pinned upstream Emiel the Blessed implements exile-then-return with Effects.Move(…, Zone.EXILE) then Effects.Move(…, Zone.BATTLEFIELD), so the exile-and-return half appears available now; reproduce before relying on this entry or deleting it.

Heroes in a Half Shell.reason: effect cannot see the whole group of creatures from one damage event

Jeweled Lotus.reason: mana spend restriction to casting a commander

Locke, Treasure Hunter.reason: cannot gather milled cards from every library and grant casting from that group

Lotus Vale.reason: enters-the-battlefield replacement that sacrifices two untapped lands

Mox Diamond.reason: enters-the-battlefield replacement that discards a land card

Mutated Cultist.reason: no primitive for 'the next spell you cast this turn costs {1} less for each counter removed this way' (GrantNextSpellFreeCast/GrantNextSpellAffinity exist, no dynamic next-spell generic reduction)

Port Town.reason: as-enters reveal-from-hand replacement (reveal a Plains or Island card or enter tapped)

Ratchet, Field Medic.reason: Living metal and convert are not represented

Twins of Discord.reason: Its static ability grants bloodthirst 2 to other colorless creatures. Pinned Argentum SDK Keyword enum has no BLOODTHIRST; no source-verified grantable replacement/counter-on-entry mechanism has been demonstrated. Do not approximate with a fixed +1/+1 anthem or unconditional counters.

Vadrok, Apex of Thunder.reason: mutate plus free cast from graveyard combination

Infect.reason: infect is not in the pinned Keyword enum; damage would not become poison/-1/-1 counters

Prowl.reason: Prowl's alternative cost is not available

Bloodthirst.reason: Pinned SDK Keyword enum lacks BLOODTHIRST, including bloodthirst N as a grantable ETB replacement; cannot silently substitute counters or a permanent stat buff.

Myriad.reason: Current integrated Argentum Myriad auto-attacks a player instead of offering that opponent or their planeswalker; CR 702.116a defender-choice gap reproduced in Android-consumer 3-player engine test.
